name: Baraki Kitan
source:
A colossal underground cavern, never once glimpsed by human eyes, and a manor built within it. A young girl, raised in this world untouched by light, lived peacefully with her beloved father and their servant. As time flowed gently by, the girl — Claritte — grew into a beautiful woman, and it seemed the days of tranquility might continue forever.

But then, Claritte's father, Clemens, was struck down by a mysterious illness, shattering the peace of the manor in the darkness. Claritte bravely retreated to her father's study in search of a cure for his strange affliction. There, she discovered a mysterious book and learned of the existence of a unique rose, said to heal any illness. The rose was said to exist only in the manor's deepest reaches, but to arrive there, one must undergo several "trials". Furthermore, the book warned that even if she were to attempt the trials, should Claritte prove unable to endure them, the path to the rose would be closed, and Clemens would meet his end at the culmination of his sickness.

One day, as Claritte dwelled on thoughts of her ailing father, the servant, Ludoana, informed her that the condition of Clemens was worsening. To the girl, resolved to save her father, the mysterious book revealed the path leading to the trials. Seeking the rose, Claritte cast herself into the darkness of the trials.

[Translated from the [url=https://druggarden.sakura.ne.jp/syoukai.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
一座从未有人见过的巨大地下洞窟，洞窟之中建有一座宅邸。一名女孩在这个不见天日的世界里长大，与深爱的父亲和仆人平静地生活着。时光缓缓流逝，女孩克拉丽特长成了美丽的女子，平静的日子仿佛会永远持续下去。

然而，克莱门斯突然染上怪病，打破了黑暗宅邸的宁静。为了寻找治愈怪病的方法，克拉丽特勇敢地前往父亲的书房。在那里，她发现一本神秘的书，也得知有一种独特的玫瑰据说能治愈任何疾病。这种玫瑰只生长在宅邸最深处，但要抵达那里，必须通过数道“试炼”。书中还警告说，即使挑战试炼，若克拉丽特无法承受，通往玫瑰的道路就会关闭，而克莱门斯也将病重而亡。

一天，克拉丽特正忧心父亲的病情，仆人卢多安娜告诉她克莱门斯的状况正在恶化。决心救父亲的克拉丽特从神秘书中得知了通往试炼之路。为了寻找玫瑰，她毅然投身于试炼的黑暗之中。
